verdict.rationale: Asking whether a real-time communications service publishes its source under an open license is a fair question, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows Cloudflare Realtime's SFU, TURN, or RealtimeKit source being published under an open license. The only open-source mention is the separate Janus project, which is not this product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
